verdict.rationale: Notion documents an official hosted Notion MCP server that MCP clients such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex connect to. It supports search, read, create, and update tools, OAuth 2.0 with PKCE client auth, workspace-owner access controls, and confirmation before write actions. An open-source self-hostable notion-mcp-server is also available, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
